newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: De Beers,union seek mediator in wage talks.
newsitem.headline: De Beers,union seek mediator in wage talks.

text.p: South African diamond giant De Beers Consolidated Mines Ltd and the National Union of Mineworkers are to appoint a mediator to facilitate further wage negotiations, the company said on Wednesday.

The agreement followed a meeting earlier in the day at which the NUM rejected a new De Beers wage proposal while also failing to amend its demand for a 10 percent wage increase for 1997, De Beers said in a statement.
De Beers is offering a nine percent increase on employees' monthly pensionable rates of pay, excluding a one percent service increment which employees will receive.

It has also offered to increase wages in 1998 and 1999, as part of an extended agreement, by nine percent excluding the allocation of an additional one percent of the basic wage bill for distribution to individuals based on their performance.
The NUM had indicated its reluctance to continue negotiating a three year agreement, the company said, adding that a date for further talks had yet to be decided.
